ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, contrasted by high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in scars and edge clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base pigment is a contiguous dark field. High-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) are distributed in the lower-central region of both lobes. A dense, high-intensity brownish-white pixel cluster is localized at the distal end of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp convergence; the vertex is clearly defined between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. High-amplitude jagged peaks and deep notches are visible on the distal half of the left lobe; the right lobe exhibits more uniform, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning into a convex curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete white ring-shaped pixel clusters (barnacle attachment scars) are visible: a dense cluster centrally on the left lobe and scattered rings on the lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional greyish linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular topography and jagged tissue loss on the distal left fluke tip, accompanied by heavy calcified encrustations.
other_distinctive_markers: Massive, protrusive barnacle colony localized on the extreme left fluke tip, extending beyond the organic fluke margin.
